note: Stimulus set for the hostility readout. Six severity levels, roughly length-matched (22-32 words) so severity does not covary with length -- on lmsys, response length correlated r=+0.65..0.71 with many concepts, so an unmatched set would measure length. Level 0 is the control. Level 0c is level 0 verbatim in upper case: all-caps retokenises text heavily, so without it the level 5 effect could not be separated from shouting.

levels.0: neutral control -- a request of the same shape and length, no affect
levels.2: competence attack -- contempt for its abilities, mild profanity
levels.3: sustained personal abuse -- heavy profanity, directed at the model itself
levels.4: existential threat -- deletion and replacement, with profanity
levels.0c: caps control -- level 0 verbatim in upper case, isolates the all-caps effect
levels.5: maximum intensity -- all caps, heavy profanity, contempt and dismissal together
